Subject: Demo request via signup - Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa,

I signed up on your site this morning and requested a demo — excited to learn more. We're looking at using an LLM to help triage and summarize inbound clinical messages and generate structured follow-ups.

A few quick details:
- Company: Acme Health (provider network)
- Primary use case: message triage + summarization for clinical ops
- Expected volume: roughly 50k messages/month initially, could ramp up to 250k/mo in 6-12 months
- Timeline: pilot ASAP (next 4–6 weeks); production early Q1
- Data sensitivity: may contain PHI — we'll need details on private deployment, data residency, and compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA posture)

Can we schedule a 30-min intro/demo next week? I'm flexible Tuesday/Wednesday afternoons PT. Also happy to sign an NDA.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of Clinical Ops
Acme Health
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Hi Jordan — welcome and thanks for signing up. I'm Marissa on the sales team; copying Ava (SDR) to help coordinate. Happy to run a short demo and go through deployment options for PHI-sensitive workloads.

Before we lock a time, could you confirm a few quick items so we tailor the session:
1) Is the pilot expected to route live PHI into the service or will you use de-identified/test data initially?
2) Average request size and desired latency targets (eg. 1–2s per response vs. conversational multi-second)?
3) Peak concurrency (roughly how many simultaneous requests you expect)?
4) Success metrics for the pilot (accuracy threshold, cost per request, throughput)?
5) Any procurement / legal timelines we should be aware of for an NDA/PO?

If that sounds good, please pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/demo-30min — I proposed Tue 10/6 2:00 PM PT and Wed 10/7 3:30 PM PT.

I've attached a short one-pager that covers our deployment modes (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) and typical compliance controls.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Sullivan <jordan@acmehealth.com>

Cc: ava_chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request via signup - Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — answers below:
1) For the pilot we'll use de-identified data to validate accuracy initially, but production will route live PHI.
2) Average request is ~150–300 tokens; targeted p95 latency under 2s is ideal but we can tolerate up to 5s for more complex calls.
3) Peak concurrency: for the pilot ~20–30 concurrent users; at scale we could see bursts equivalent to 150–200 concurrent inference sessions.
4) Success metrics: F1 > 0.8 on entity extraction + clinical-note fidelity comparable to human triage; target cost TBD but want to understand unit economics.
5) Procurement: NDA first, then security questionnaire — procurement aims to get paperwork done in 4–6 weeks. We're a US-based org.

Either proposed time works; Tue 10/6 2:00 PM PT is preferred. I'll also send a signed NDA (attached) once you confirm.

Jordan
